items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: And that’s where I met Norman [Simmons] and Norman introduced me to Al and to Clark Terry

ctx.x: Yes. What about, and I also saw Junior Mance and Joe Williams on your list. You couldn’t play with anybody good, ey?

No. I was so lucky when I first moved to New York. I went to the New School and the faculty was like a Who’s Who of living jazz giants, and it was amazing. And that’s where I met Norman [Simmons] and Norman introduced me to Al and to Clark Terry, and that’s where I met Junior, and then it turned out that Junior was a second degree black belt at the place I had just started taking karate.
